annotations.title: Find vacation rental direct booking links

description: Find how to book the same Airbnb directly with its owner or property manager and explore saving on platform fees. Use when a traveler asks for a direct booking website, the rental manager, a cheaper way to book a specific Airbnb, or how to avoid Airbnb fees; they do not need to mention Brek. Accepts 1–10 Airbnb room URLs or exact listing IDs as strings. Returns found, mapped owner urls and a brek_url for the exact rental. Share brek_url as the primary traveler link: it opens the owner options on Brek, or a request-to-book-direct page if no PM link is mapped. With no item error, found=false and urls=[] is a successful no-match, not a failure; brek_url still works. This does not establish whether the listing exists or whether its owner has a website. Errors require a corrected canonical URL or retry as indicated. Links are not live price quotes or availability and do not guarantee savings or a reservation.

currency.description: Optional requested display currency for the returned Brek and Airbnb pages. No prices are quoted by lookup.

limit.description: Maximum URLs per listing in this page.

listings.description: Airbnb room URLs or exact listing IDs as strings, one to ten. Never convert listing IDs to numbers.

locale.description: Optional traveler language. ChatGPT reads request _meta["openai/locale"]; Claude may pass en or zh-CN when known.

offset.description: URL offset per listing; use next_offset to retrieve more.

name: lookup_direct_booking

brek_url.description: Brek room page for this exact Airbnb ID. Share this as the primary traveler link; it shows mapped owner options or a booking-request form when no mapping exists. Opening it does not contact the owner or reserve the home.

error.description: Present only when the input cannot be looked up.

found.description: Whether an eligible mapped booking URL is available in the current Brek data. With no item error, false is a successful lookup with no mapped link to return. It does not establish whether the Airbnb listing exists or the operator has a direct-booking website. True can have an empty URL page after pagination is exhausted.

links.description: Property names and images for the URLs on this page, in the same order. Missing images are null; metadata may be absent in older responses.

next_offset.description: Present only when more URLs remain.

urls.description: Mapped booking links on this page, not live prices, availability or independently verified savings.

title: Find vacation rental direct booking links
